item.title: Anthropic listing under pressure: Investors question timing and sky-high valuation
item.description: Anthropic's proposed $100 billion IPO faces uncertainty as investors question its $1.5 trillion valuation amid a global AI sell-off, rising infrastructure costs and concerns over profitability.

item.title: BMW Industries Q2 Results: Net profit rise 43% YoY to Rs 21.62 crore
item.description: BMW Industries Ltd has reported an impressive 42.7 percent increase in net profit for the quarter ending on September 30. The firm's total income surged by 33 percent compared to the same quarter last fiscal year, while EBITDA rose by 25 percent, showcasing its resilience and growth. Notably, the new greenfield downstream steel complex in Bokaro commenced operations, with future plans focused on optimizing capacity utilization across these facilities.

item.title: HCC Q2 profit slumps 53% to Rs 22 crore
item.description: Hindustan Construction Company reported a decline in consolidated net profit for the September quarter of FY27. Income and expenses also saw a reduction in comparison to the previous year's figures. The company secured an order of Rs 524 crore and participated in several project bids. Additionally, construction progressed on various projects including the Indore and Patna Metro.

item.title: Rupee falls 9 paise to 94.50 against US dollar in early trade
item.description: In early trading on Friday, the rupee slipped by 9 paise to reach 94.50 against the US dollar, driven by a robust dollar and surging crude oil prices. After a brief bounce-back, it peaked at 94.36. The domestic equity market exhibited mixed performance, with Sensex rising yet Nifty falling. Notably, Foreign Institutional Investors remained active, purchasing substantial equities, bolstering market optimism.

item.title: India bonds emerge as top Asian performers as oil, Treasury yields decline
item.description: This week, Indian government bonds saw a positive trend following a Democratic win in the U.S. midterm elections. The reduction in oil prices and Treasury yields eased rupee pressure, boosting investor confidence. The benchmark bond yield improved significantly, declining by approximately 22 basis points. Furthermore, the surge in foreign investments into Indian bonds marked a notable high since July, leading to enhanced overall market sentiment.
